title: interview-runner self-host configuration
description: The only host configuration. Validated by `node server-dist/selfhost.mjs env` inside the runner image (scripts/selfhost.ts mirrors these rules). Secrets never belong here.

stack.description: Instance name: Compose project, container-name prefix and sandbox instance scope.

port.description: Loopback port the runner is published on (127.0.0.1 only).

owner.description: Content namespace of the courses at the root of the content checkout, and the workspace the Library opens by default. Directories under namespaces/<name>/ import as <name>. Changing it after first use leaves existing Library placements under the old name.

content.description: Course content: a git repository cloned by `make sync` with the host's git credentials, or an existing directory (absolute, or ./… relative to config.json) mounted read-only.

db.description: Host path of the single user SQLite database: absolute, or ./… relative to config.json. content.db (cache), the git checkout, managed state and backups live next to it.

private.description: Optional host directory of personal overrides kept outside the package: keybindings.json and settings.json replace the sandbox editor defaults (editor changes are written back to them), and legacy-reading.json lists the deprecated reading drills this host still serves, as {"<course-id>": ["<drill-id>"]}. Every file is optional.
